outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic with accompanying western blots; it is not a plot of averaged data and does not require individual data points.

Bar charts show single densitometry quantification values (% FT depletion, log2 elution abundance) per antibody with no error bars, indicating these are not averages across replicates that would require overlaid individual points.
Panel C is a heatmap, which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel D consists of violin plots, which already display the full data distribution and are exempt from this check.
Bar charts of mean ± SD (n=4) show individual data points overlaid as circles for Htt, F8a1, and Synj1 measurements.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a scatterplot; individual points are the data itself, so this is exempt.
Panel H is a scatterplot of individual IP-MS experiments; exempt from the check.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot showing individual samples as points; exempt from the check.
Panel J is a set of PCA scatterplots showing individual samples as points; exempt from the check.
